Load ITN efficacy parameters from the built-in database

Source: R/itn_params.R
get_ITN_params.Rd

Returns efficacy parameters and per-component insecticide half-lives for a named net type and experimental hut trial (EHT), ready to be passed directly to build_intervention.

Two model modes are supported:

  • "standard" (default): three-host model with Deterrency, PrePrandial, and PostPrandial.

  • "dummy_host": four-host model with Deterrency, KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute, and PostPrandial. Deterrency and PostPrandial are required in both modes.

The returned halflife_insecticide vector encodes per-component insecticide decay as a linear decay (in years). Despite the name, it is the time at which the effect reaches zero, calibrated so that efficacy at the aging time of the trial's washed arm (aged_time: 3 years, 2 for Sovegnon) equals the washed value. Negative values (efficacy increased with washing) are returned as fitted. To use the unwashed efficacy throughout, pass insecticide_decay = FALSE to build_intervention.

In the experimental hut model, host-seeking killing is fitted relative to the availability alpha_0 of the trial's control arm (extra host-seeking mortality KillingDuringHostSeekingRelative * alpha_0). Since alpha_0 varies widely between trials, relative values are not comparable across trials. With rescale_hsk = TRUE, the returned KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute is the absolute value KillingDuringHostSeekingRelative * alpha_0, using the control alpha_0 of the same arm (unwashed or washed fit), and its insecticide decay is recomputed from the absolute unwashed and washed values, with the trial's aged_time. The model uses the absolute value only.

Usage

get_ITN_params(
  net_type,
  EHT,
  mode = "standard",
  washed = FALSE,
  rescale_hsk = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

net_type

Character string; net type label as in the netType column of ITN_parameterisations_Champagne2025. Use list_ITN_params to see available values.

EHT

Character string; experimental hut trial identifier as in the EHT column.

mode

Character; "standard" (default) for the three-host model or "dummy_host" for the four-host model.

washed

Logical (default FALSE). If FALSE, returns Unwashed (new net) efficacy values; if TRUE, returns Washed values.

rescale_hsk

Logical (default TRUE); dummy-host mode only. If TRUE, multiply host-seeking killing by the control alpha_0 of its arm (see Details). If FALSE, return the fitted relative value as KillingDuringHostSeekingRelative (with its fitted decay), e.g. to rescale it with another alpha_0; build_intervention does not accept it (convert it to KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute first).

verbose

Logical (default TRUE). Print a summary of the loaded parameterisation.

Value

Named list with:

  • efficacy: named numeric vector for the efficacy argument of build_intervention.

  • halflife_insecticide: named numeric vector (years) encoding a linear per-component decay (time to zero). Pass directly to the halflife_insecticide argument of build_intervention.

  • mode: the model structure ("standard" or "dummy_host"), for build_intervention(mode = ).

  • name: suggested intervention label ("net_type (EHT)").

  • reference: citation string from the dataset.

  • alpha_0: control availabilities c(Unwashed, Washed) used to rescale host-seeking killing, or NULL if no rescaling was done.

See also

list_ITN_params, build_intervention

Author

Clara Champagne, clara.champagne@swisstph.ch

Examples

# Standard three-host model
itn_p = get_ITN_params("Interceptor G2", "Kibondo")
#> ITN parameterisation loaded: Interceptor G2 (Kibondo) 
#> Mode: standard 
#> Reference: Kibondo et al. 
#> Efficacy (unwashed):
#> PostPrandial  PrePrandial   Deterrency 
#>         0.52         0.44         0.71 
#> Insecticide decay, linear time to zero (years; omitted = no decay):
#> PostPrandial  PrePrandial   Deterrency 
#>         31.2         66.0        -71.0 
itn_p$efficacy
#> PostPrandial  PrePrandial   Deterrency 
#>         0.52         0.44         0.71 
itn_p$halflife_insecticide
#> PostPrandial  PrePrandial   Deterrency 
#>         31.2         66.0        -71.0 

# Dummy-host (four-host) model
itn_dh = get_ITN_params("Interceptor G2", "Kibondo", mode = "dummy_host")
#> ITN parameterisation loaded: Interceptor G2 (Kibondo) 
#> Mode: dummy_host 
#> Reference: Kibondo et al. 
#> Efficacy (unwashed):
#>                     PostPrandial                       Deterrency 
#>                            0.520                            0.710 
#> KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute 
#>                            0.609 
#> Host-seeking killing rescaled by the control alpha_0 (unwashed 0.17, washed 0.16)
#> Insecticide decay, linear time to zero (years; omitted = no decay):
#>                     PostPrandial                       Deterrency 
#>                           31.200                          -71.000 
#> KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute 
#>                           28.981 
itn_dh$efficacy
#>                     PostPrandial                       Deterrency 
#>                           0.5200                           0.7100 
#> KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute 
#>                           0.6086
